name: aisgroup-design
description: AIS Group design system: the brand guide, the @aisgroup/design components and their playground, the Claude Code plugin and the hosted MCP.

scripts.build: npm run build -w guide && npm run build -w playground && npm run build -w hosted
scripts.test: node scripts/check-tokens.mjs && node --test scripts/tests/*.test.mjs && npm run typecheck -w @aisgroup/design && npm test -w @aisgroup/design-lint && npm test -w plugin && npm test -w hosted && node scripts/check-components.mjs && node scripts/check-web.mjs && node scripts/check-spec.mjs && npm run test:search -w guide
